name: Client Lua loader: CoA interface pieces arrive after login and again after a /reload, with stored settings
contract: A client with the hot-patch channel announces CMSG 0x8F1 (protocol 1, mode 2) after entering the world, and
the server loads the CoARotation button and the CoACompanions frame into it as SMSG 0x8F0. A /reload loses
them; the client announces its reloaded interface with CMSG_SET_ACTIONBAR_TOGGLES (0x2BF), and about 1.5
seconds later the server sends them again. A setting saved with the COAUI<TAB>SAVE whisper is stored per
character and travels with the piece after the next login; a setting with characters outside the allowed set
is dropped. Expected: both pieces after login, at least both again after 0x2BF, the stored scale after a relog
and no trace of the rejected value. The client's rendering of the button and the frame is not exercised here.

steps.label: The client announces the hot-patch channel
The CoARotation button arrives after login
The CoACompanions frame arrives after login
The reloaded interface reports its action bars
DISCRIMINATING: a reload brings both pieces back
The client announces the hot-patch channel again
The stored scale travels with the button after the relog
A setting with a quote is rejected
